The artifact quantizes the MTP block's 288 routed experts as exl3 trellis payload groups, so the census is the 25 non-expert names of m2-layer45-unexpected-keys.json plus 3,456 payload objects (864 modules x {trellis,suh,svh,mcg}); no weight_scale_inv siblings exist anywhere in this release
